heading: Two ways to learn with us
intro: Choose care for the week, tuition for focused learning, or both.

items.title: Weekday daycare
items.text: Safe, nurturing care from Monday to Friday, with meals, rest, creative play and outdoor time built into the day.

items.title: Tuition classes
items.text: Small-group classes on weekends and weeknights in maths, English and science, taught through games and hands-on activities.
